title: Algebra action maps and the balancing morphism on sheaf tensors
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $B,C$ sheaves of commutative $\mathcal O_Y$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], $\varphi:B\to C$ an algebra morphism, and $P$ a sheaf of $B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $P_0$ for scalar restriction to $\mathcal O_Y$, $B_0,C_0$ for the underlying modules, $S=C_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}P_0$, $F=B_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}S$, and $T=(C\otimes_B P)|_{\mathcal O_Y}$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $\tau$ for the canonical pure tensor sections and $\eta$ for the sectionwise change-of-rings sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. There exist $\mathcal O_Y$-linear morphisms $a,d:F\to S$ and $g:S\to T$ such that, on every open $W$, $a_W(\tau(b,\tau(c,p)))=\tau(c,bp)$, $d_W(\tau(b,\tau(c,p)))=\tau(\varphi_W(b)c,p)$, and $g_W(\tau(c,p))=\eta_W(c\otimes_B p)$ for all $b\in B(W),c\in C(W),p\in P(W)$, and $a\circ g=d\circ g$, with composition written in diagrammatic order.

proof.text: The sectionwise B-actions on K=C tensor_O P, acting on P or through phi on C, are additive, O-balanced and natural. Sheafify these B-module presheaves; restriction to O agrees with the O-module sheafification of K, by the common associated additive sheaf and uniqueness of the induced scalar action. This supplies the two actions on S. Their bilinear action maps extend through B tensor_O S to a and d. The sheafification unit preserves the pure tensor formulas.

The natural sectionwise balancing map C tensor_O P -> C tensor_B P followed by eta extends to g:S->T. Its defining factorization yields the displayed formula. The B-tensor balancing identity makes a followed by g and d followed by g agree on b tensor (c tensor p). Pure tensor generation before each sheafification, then uniqueness of sheafification twice, proves equality of these morphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_changeOfRings_tensor_action_maps (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (φ : B ⟶ C)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B.right)) :
    let P₀ := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P
    let S := tensorObj C.toModule P₀
    let T := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 C.hom)).obj
      (SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} φ.right P)
    ∃ (a d : tensorObj B.toModule S ⟶ S) (g : S ⟶ T),
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W))
          (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        a.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule) b
          (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p)) =
          tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c (b • p)) ∧
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W))
          (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        d.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule) b
          (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p)) =
          tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) (φ.right.hom.app (op W) b * c) p) ∧
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        g.app W (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p) =
          (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 C.right).obj)).unit.app
            (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} φ.right P)).app (op W))
              (c ⊗ₜ[B.right.obj.obj (op W), (φ.right.hom.app (op W)).hom] p)) ∧
      a ≫ g = d ≫ g
